user_payload.original_question: 为可见光吸热涂料的光谱选择性表面设计吸收膜：在 400-700 nm 可见波段吸收率尽可能高（反射率尽可能低），而在 700-2000 nm 近红外波段反射率尽可能高以抑制热输入。请在空气入射、铝基底条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 与金属 Cr 设计一个平面多层膜，膜系总层数不超过 20 层。

execution_protocol.original_question_policy: Preserve original_question verbatim; these assumptions are separate from original user constraints.
assumptions: Use 0 degree incidence, equal-s/p unpolarized light and wavelength-integral band means as separately labeled execution assumptions, not original user facts.
Treat the stated aluminum substrate as a semi-infinite absorbing exit medium for this planar-surface calculation; disclose this boundary assumption.
requirements: Use the original explicit low-reflectance parenthetical to minimize mean R in 400–700 nm, and maximize mean R in 700–2000 nm. Preserve the user absorption motivation, HfO2/SiO2/Cr film allowance, aluminum substrate, air incidence and at most 20 layers.

A_finite=1-R-T_into_exit measures finite-film absorption only. Do not label it coating-plus-substrate absorption. For the stated absorbing semi-infinite surface system, 1-R is system absorptance; this does not add a third optimization goal or a heat-power objective.
No global user thickness bounds were specified. Use finite positive model-proposed family domains without inventing manufacturing constraints.
